# Core commands

## `core.accounts.invites.create`

Create an invite link code for someone new, who picks their own username and password.

- CLI: `media admin invites create`
- Kind: action
- Scope: admin
- API keys: refused
- Arguments: `{ role?: "admin" | "member"; expiresInDays?: number }`
- Result: `{ inviteId: Id<"invites">; code: string; expiresAt: number }`

## `core.accounts.invites.list`

List the invites that still work, latest to expire first.

- CLI: `media admin invites list`
- Kind: query
- Scope: admin
- Arguments: `{ paginationOpts: { numItems: number; cursor: string | null; endCursor?: string | null; id?: number; maximumRowsRead?: number; maximumBytesRead?: number } }`
- Pages: `--limit <n>` (default 100) and `--cursor <continueCursor>`
- Result: `{ page: Array<{ inviteId: Id<"invites">; role: "admin" | "member"; invitedBy: string; expiresAt: number }>; continueCursor: string; isDone: boolean; splitCursor?: string | null; pageStatus?: "SplitRecommended" | "SplitRequired" | null }`

## `core.accounts.invites.lookup`

Show what an invite code offers, or refuse it when it no longer works.

- CLI: `media auth invites lookup`
- Kind: query
- Scope: public
- Arguments: `{ code: string }`
- Secret: `code` from `MEDIA_ARG_CODE` or stdin, never a flag
- Result: `{ role: "admin" | "member"; invitedBy: string; expiresAt: number }`

## `core.accounts.invites.revoke`

Revoke an invite so its code stops working.

- CLI: `media admin invites revoke`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: admin
- Arguments: `{ inviteId: Id<"invites"> }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.libraries.rename`

Rename a library you manage.

- CLI: `media auth libraries rename`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ libraryId: Id<"libraries">; name: string }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.libraries.scan`

Scan a library for new, changed, and missing files, or join the scan already queued.

- CLI: `media auth libraries scan`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ libraryId: Id<"libraries"> }`
- Result: `{ jobId: Id<"jobs">; created: boolean }`

## `core.libraries.setFolders`

Change the folders of a library you manage; what a removed folder held leaves the library.

- CLI: `media admin libraries set-folders`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: admin
- API keys: refused
- Arguments: `{ libraryId: Id<"libraries">; folders: Array<string> }`
- Result: `{ scanJobId: Id<"jobs"> | null }`

## `core.permissions.grants.list`

List who something you manage is shared with, and at which level.

- CLI: `media auth grants list`
- Kind: query
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ resource: { type: "library"; id: Id<"libraries"> }; paginationOpts: { numItems: number; cursor: string | null; endCursor?: string | null; id?: number; maximumRowsRead?: number; maximumBytesRead?: number } }`
- Pages: `--limit <n>` (default 100) and `--cursor <continueCursor>`
- Result: `{ page: Array<{ principal: { kind: "user"; userId: Id<"users">; username: string } | { kind: "group"; groupId: Id<"groups">; name: string } | { kind: "household" }; level: "view" | "edit" | "manage" }>; continueCursor: string; isDone: boolean; splitCursor?: string | null; pageStatus?: "SplitRecommended" | "SplitRequired" | null }`

## `core.permissions.grants.remove`

Stop sharing something you manage with someone, or leave what was shared with you.

- CLI: `media auth grants remove`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ resource: { type: "library"; id: Id<"libraries"> }; principal: { kind: "user"; userId: Id<"users"> } | { kind: "group"; groupId: Id<"groups"> } | { kind: "household" } }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.permissions.grants.set`

Share something you manage with a person, a group, or everyone, at exactly one level.

- CLI: `media auth grants set`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- API keys: refused
- Arguments: `{ resource: { type: "library"; id: Id<"libraries"> }; principal: { kind: "user"; userId: Id<"users"> } | { kind: "group"; groupId: Id<"groups"> } | { kind: "household" }; level: "view" | "edit" | "manage" }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.permissions.groups.addMember`

Add someone to a group; what is shared with it reaches them on their next call.

- CLI: `media admin groups add-member`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: admin
- API keys: refused
- Arguments: `{ groupId: Id<"groups">; userId: Id<"users"> }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.permissions.groups.create`

Create a group of people to share with at once.

- CLI: `media admin groups create`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: admin
- Arguments: `{ name: string }`
- Result: `{ groupId: Id<"groups"> }`

## `core.permissions.groups.list`

List the groups by name.

- CLI: `media admin groups list`
- Kind: query
- Scope: admin
- Arguments: `{ paginationOpts: { numItems: number; cursor: string | null; endCursor?: string | null; id?: number; maximumRowsRead?: number; maximumBytesRead?: number } }`
- Pages: `--limit <n>` (default 100) and `--cursor <continueCursor>`
- Result: `{ page: Array<{ groupId: Id<"groups">; name: string }>; continueCursor: string; isDone: boolean; splitCursor?: string | null; pageStatus?: "SplitRecommended" | "SplitRequired" | null }`

## `core.permissions.groups.members`

List the people in a group.

- CLI: `media admin groups members`
- Kind: query
- Scope: admin
- Arguments: `{ groupId: Id<"groups">; paginationOpts: { numItems: number; cursor: string | null; endCursor?: string | null; id?: number; maximumRowsRead?: number; maximumBytesRead?: number } }`
- Pages: `--limit <n>` (default 100) and `--cursor <continueCursor>`
- Result: `{ page: Array<{ userId: Id<"users">; username: string }>; continueCursor: string; isDone: boolean; splitCursor?: string | null; pageStatus?: "SplitRecommended" | "SplitRequired" | null }`

## `core.permissions.groups.remove`

Delete a group, so what was shared with it no longer reaches its members.

- CLI: `media admin groups remove`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: admin
- Arguments: `{ groupId: Id<"groups"> }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.permissions.groups.removeMember`

Take someone out of a group; what is shared with it stops reaching them at once.

- CLI: `media admin groups remove-member`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: admin
- Arguments: `{ groupId: Id<"groups">; userId: Id<"users"> }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.permissions.groups.rename`

Rename a group.

- CLI: `media admin groups rename`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: admin
- Arguments: `{ groupId: Id<"groups">; name: string }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.restrictions.get`

Show a kid's limits on what they see, yours or as an admin someone else's.

- CLI: `media auth restrictions get`
- Kind: query
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ userId: Id<"users"> }`
- Result: `{ maxMovieAge: number | null; hideUnrated: boolean; hideExplicitMusic: boolean; libraries: Array<Id<"libraries">> | null } | null`

## `core.restrictions.set`

Limit what a member sees by movie rating, explicit music, and library, or lift the limits.

- CLI: `media admin restrictions set`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: admin
- API keys: refused
- Arguments: `{ userId: Id<"users">; restrictions: { maxMovieAge: number | null; hideUnrated: boolean; hideExplicitMusic: boolean; libraries: Array<Id<"libraries">> | null } | null }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.server.info`

Show this server's name and version, and whether its owner has set it up.

- CLI: `media auth server info`
- Kind: query
- Scope: public
- Arguments: none
- Result: `{ name: string; version: string; hasOwner: boolean }`

## `core.settings.get`

Show your settings: the ones that follow you to every device, and your own on this device.

- CLI: `media auth settings get`
- Kind: query
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: none
- Result: `{ user: { subtitleLanguage: string | null; audioLanguage: string | null; subtitleStyle: { size: "small" | "medium" | "large"; color: "white" | "yellow"; backdrop: "none" | "shadow" | "box" }; autoplay: boolean; explicitFilter: boolean; crossfade: number; gapless: boolean }; device: { streamQuality: "auto" | "original" | "high" | "standard" | "low"; downloadQuality: "standard" | "high"; volume: number } | null }`

## `core.settings.set`

Change some of your settings; each follows you or stays on this device, as the settings table marks it.

- CLI: `media auth settings set`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ subtitleLanguage?: string | null; audioLanguage?: string | null; subtitleStyle?: { size: "small" | "medium" | "large"; color: "white" | "yellow"; backdrop: "none" | "shadow" | "box" }; autoplay?: boolean; explicitFilter?: boolean; crossfade?: number; gapless?: boolean; streamQuality?: "auto" | "original" | "high" | "standard" | "low"; downloadQuality?: "standard" | "high"; volume?: number }`
- Result: `{ user: { subtitleLanguage: string | null; audioLanguage: string | null; subtitleStyle: { size: "small" | "medium" | "large"; color: "white" | "yellow"; backdrop: "none" | "shadow" | "box" }; autoplay: boolean; explicitFilter: boolean; crossfade: number; gapless: boolean }; device: { streamQuality: "auto" | "original" | "high" | "standard" | "low"; downloadQuality: "standard" | "high"; volume: number } | null }`

## `core.together.add`

Queue something you can play in your group session, next or at the end.

- CLI: `media auth together add`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ item: { domain: "movies"; ref: { type: "probeMovie"; id: Id<"probeItems"> } } | { domain: "music"; ref: { type: "probeTrack"; id: Id<"probeItems"> } }; at?: "next" | "end" }`
- Result: `{ entryId: Id<"togetherEntries"> }`

## `core.together.admit`

Let someone waiting to join your group session in, as its host.

- CLI: `media auth together admit`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music"; userId: Id<"users"> }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.together.block`

Remove someone from your group session or turn their request away, as its host; its join link no longer lets them in.

- CLI: `media auth together block`
- Kind: action
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music"; userId: Id<"users"> }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.together.configure`

Set who may join your group session and whether its guests may control playback and add items.

- CLI: `media auth together configure`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music"; join: "open" | "approval" | "locked"; control: boolean; add: boolean }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.together.control`

Play, pause, seek, change the speed of, or skip to the next item in your group session.

- CLI: `media auth together control`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music"; op: { kind: "play" } | { kind: "pause" } | { kind: "rate"; playbackRate: number } | { kind: "seek"; positionMs: number; revision: number } | { kind: "next"; revision: number } }`
- Result: `{ status: "playing" | "paused"; positionAtAnchorMs: number; anchorServerTime: number; playbackRate: number; revision: number }`

## `core.together.create`

Start a group session on something you can play, leaving any session you are a guest in, and get its join link.

- CLI: `media auth together create`
- Kind: action
- Scope: signed-in
- API keys: refused
- Arguments: `{ item: { domain: "movies"; ref: { type: "probeMovie"; id: Id<"probeItems"> } } | { domain: "music"; ref: { type: "probeTrack"; id: Id<"probeItems"> } }; join?: "open" | "approval" | "locked"; control?: boolean; add?: boolean }`
- Result: `{ sessionId: Id<"togetherSessions">; link: string }`

## `core.together.get`

Show your group session in a domain: its clock, item, members, settings, link, and what you may do.

- CLI: `media auth together get`
- Kind: query
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music" }`
- Result: `null | { state: "pending"; sessionId: Id<"togetherSessions">; host: string } | { state: "ended"; sessionId: Id<"togetherSessions">; reason: "host-left" | "abandoned" } | { state: "joined"; sessionId: Id<"togetherSessions">; host: string; role: "host" | "guest"; link: string; settings: { join: "open" | "approval" | "locked"; control: boolean; add: boolean }; may: { control: boolean; add: boolean; manage: boolean }; clock: { status: "playing" | "paused"; positionAtAnchorMs: number; anchorServerTime: number; playbackRate: number; revision: number }; item: { domain: "movies"; ref: { type: "probeMovie"; id: Id<"probeItems"> } } | { domain: "music"; ref: { type: "probeTrack"; id: Id<"probeItems"> } } | null; members: Array<{ userId: Id<"users">; username: string; role: "host" | "guest"; present: boolean; linkGuest: boolean }>; pending: Array<{ userId: Id<"users">; username: string; present: boolean }> | null }`

## `core.together.heartbeat`

Keep yourself present in your group session in a domain and read the server clock.

- CLI: `media auth together heartbeat`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music" }`
- Result: `{ serverTime: number }`

## `core.together.join`

Join the group session a link opens, or wait for its host to let you in; leaves your other session in this domain.

- CLI: `media auth together join`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music"; link: string }`
- Secret: `link` from `MEDIA_ARG_LINK` or stdin, never a flag
- Result: `{ state: "joined" | "pending" }`

## `core.together.leave`

Leave your group session in a domain; when you host it, it ends for everyone.

- CLI: `media auth together leave`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music" }`
- Result: `null`

## `core.together.queue`

List what plays next in your group session in a domain.

- CLI: `media auth together queue`
- Kind: query
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music"; paginationOpts: { numItems: number; cursor: string | null; endCursor?: string | null; id?: number; maximumRowsRead?: number; maximumBytesRead?: number } }`
- Pages: `--limit <n>` (default 100) and `--cursor <continueCursor>`
- Result: `{ page: Array<{ entryId: Id<"togetherEntries">; item: { domain: "movies"; ref: { type: "probeMovie"; id: Id<"probeItems"> } } | { domain: "music"; ref: { type: "probeTrack"; id: Id<"probeItems"> } } | null; addedBy: string | null; removable: boolean }>; continueCursor: string; isDone: boolean; splitCursor?: string | null; pageStatus?: "SplitRecommended" | "SplitRequired" | null }`

## `core.together.remove`

Take an entry out of your group session's queue: any as its host, your own as a guest.

- CLI: `media auth together remove`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: signed-in
- Arguments: `{ domain: "movies" | "music"; entryId: Id<"togetherEntries"> }`
- Result: `null`
